reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the idea of a nearly temperature-independent lattice thermal conductivity from studies on other HEAs (P9, P19) and the role of force-constant disorder (P12, P42) and applies it specifically to HfNbTaTiZr, proposing a decoupled computational approach that separately computes lattice and electronic contributions using full phonon dispersions from MD and DFT, which no single passage proposes. It also defines a quantitative falsification test with independent experimental decoupling, going beyond the cited literature.
